items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I played with Zutty a few nights only, I think.

ctx.x: Yeah. So then Dicky Wells just got tired. We didn't even have Zutty Singleton on the job, we had Zutty there with him. And Zutty got tired, you can read that thing in "Down Beat" about that, too, Zutty did. He got tired, he said all musicians in Europe were starving, which is not true, see. That's what he said, see. But it was a lot of musicians out of work (laughs), that, you know, is true. Negro musicians, I mean, is true. So I had a chance to join him on account of Dicky Wells just got tired and left. It was…
'Cause you knew Coleman would end up in Paris sooner or later -
